drinks.line: Baby, if I wasn't holding all these drinks
drinks.lineNext: Something 'bout the way Violet whips her hair

drinks.line: The ice cubes would clink as they freshened their drinks
stanza: Sadly they stared and sank in their chairs
And searched for a comforting notion
And the rich silver walls looked ready to fall
As they shook in doubtful devotion
The ice cubes would clink as they freshened their drinks
Wet their minds in bitter emotion
And they talked about the ringing of revolution
The trouble is he drinks!

drinks.line: And I will say thanks if you're pouring my drinks
stanza: But I still sing glory from my high rise
And I will say thanks if you're pouring my drinks
While the world waits for an explosion
That moment in time when we'll be set free
The trouble is he stinks!
If a man can't see his shadow, oh
He can block your sun all day
He can make you small
He has the power to take his love away
Six hours on the Grapevine
And I feel kidnapped this time
'Cause my baby thinks
He always believes
That he's always right
But I still think of him at night
Becky clears up from the lunch rush Crushed
By the blank eyes
Impolite customers thrusting
Their damp fives
Into her palms, she thinks
'There ain’t no harm in being civil though, Is there?'
